verdict.rationale: The public register lets a founder search for their company and 'view company data and document images', and 'Follow companies' to track changes. That means accepted filings and overall company status (including dissolved companies) are publicly visible, but nothing shows a status tracker for a pending filing, application or case. Missing for 10: an evidenced public status page or reference-number lookup for in-progress filings, applications or cases, any documentation of filing states (received, processing, rejected), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
